SELECT address AS "address!: AddressId"
           FROM telegram_subscriptions_entity
           WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL
           UNION
           SELECT address AS "address!: AddressId"
           FROM ntfy_subscriptions_entity
           WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL
           UNION
           SELECT address AS "address!: AddressId"
           FROM push_subscription_entity
           WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL
